notes.notes:

Have you try our lastest games yet? Trust me, They are fun and will burn out your calories. lol

Sky walker (Butt-kick) is a game that lets you walk on the sky while collecting those precious coins. My advice is to kick your legs up high enough to kick your butt, that's how exercise works.

Hell Chicken (180 Jump Squat) is so rock! You will be a hero who saving little eggs from the hell flame. Turn jump 180 degrees and squat down to balance the platform.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Fitforce is fully released!
notes.notes:
[h1]FITFORCE IS FULLY RELEASED![/h1]

We are very happy to announce that Fitforce moves out of Early Access. We have optimized and fixed a lot of things to prevent most bugs and issues occurring during the Early Access, and we add a lot of new things along the way. We wouldn’t come this far without our beta and early access players so we want to thank you for giving us valuable feedback to help us reach this state.

Here is the summary of new things added into Fitforce apart from bug fixes and optimizations.
[list]
[*]Rotation System: get free access to 2 premium minigames on weekly rotation.
[*]New UI for Classic Mode: see all the necessary details at first glance.
[*]Upgraded Program Mode: select from preset exercise program to work out or create your own exercise program that you enjoy.
[*]Health Monthly Report: see your workout progress across the whole month.
[*]2 new premium minigames:
[olist]
[*]Santa Express, become the Santa Clause and deliver gifts to the houses with the Scissor Chop exercise.
[*]Gold Rush, dig deep into the gold mine and harvest the gold with the Punch exercise.
[/olist]
[/list]
[h3][b]Have fun and get fit.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: A letter to Chinese players
notes.notes:
Dear Lovely Chinese Players,

It has been more than a month since Fitforce (early access) has been launched. Since release date, most of the players are Thai. However, We surprisingly have a lot of new players from China in the past 2 days. We would like to thank you for your interest in our game. We are greatly appreciated. 非常感谢

At first, we didn’t know that Fitforce will be famous in China this fast, so there are some problems about [u]downloading mobile app[/u] from store (Mostly from Android) and [u]login method[/u]. We will find a way to fix the problems but it might takes some times since Fitforce is developed by a very small team. Sorry for an inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

[u]What else are in our consideration?[/u]
- Add Chinese to alternative language 
- Other payment methods
- Official Chinese social media channel

A big thanks to you all again. Please help telling us what app store do you use apart from Apple app store and Google play store, what is your preferred payment method and if you have any other problems or feedback [u]please discuss below[/u]. 

We won't stop developing. We are just in the beginning of the journey and want you to walk with us. 

Sincerely,
Fitforce Developer Team
